title: Introducing Visual Scenes and Reasoning: A More Realistic Benchmark for Spoken Language Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how flawed or hallucinated reasoning steps generated by multimodal large language models negatively impact the accuracy of their subsequent label predictions. The paper measures this by comparing the performance of models that generate reasoning before label prediction against models using the proposed LR-Instruct method, which predicts labels first and generates reasoning second.
